english.note: Use this for the act or process of making something simpler, especially in formal or written contexts; it is the all-purpose abstract term for that meaning.

examples.english: This simplification of the procedures has greatly shortened the application time.
examples.traditional: 今次手續簡化，大大縮短咗申請時間。
